# Make targets

> **Status:** Current · **Type:** reference · **Tier:** —

<!-- Generated by `make docs-reference`. Edit the source, not this file. -->

The Makefile is the canonical operator surface and `make help` prints this
list. Targets that use cloud credentials, inventory, SSH or decrypted
secrets need user authorization first; `AGENTS.md` lists them under
decision boundaries. A variable shown as `$NAME` takes its value from the
environment or from the git-ignored `.fleet.mk`.

```text
vpn-deploy Makefile
  workspace-status  Read-only local checkout provenance (no fetch or fleet configuration)

Variables (override on command line):
  PROVIDER  current: $PROVIDER  (upcloud | hetzner | vultr | scaleway)
  ENV       current: $ENV       (prod | staging)
  ANSIBLE_LIMIT             Host/group limit for live Ansible targets; exactly one alias for rotate-credentials and rollback-*
  ANSIBLE_EXTRA_VARS_FILE   Optional limited same-owner mode-0600 YAML; requires ANSIBLE_LIMIT
  DEPLOY_SSH_CONTEXTS_FILE  Required mode-0600 JSON mapping: exact alias → 2–8 SSH contexts
  DEPLOY_PROMOTION_CONFIG_FILE  Deploy-only mode-0600 JSON mapping: exact alias → promotion proof config
  DEPLOY_SSH_BASELINE_FAILURE_RECEIPTS_FILE  Deploy-only mode-0600 JSON mapping: exact alias → fresh private baseline failure receipt

── DAY-1 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  check-prereqs              Verify required CLI tools are installed
  bootstrap-secrets …        Generate full crypto + SOPS-encrypt
  setup-yubikey [REENCRYPT=1]  Hardware-backed age identity on YubiKey
  scan-targets {SEEDS=…|CIDR=…|CRAWL=…}  Discover REALITY targets (RealiTLScanner)
  validate-target            Bounded REALITY target validation (local hygiene only)
  monitor-reality-target     Daily ASN/path signal from an explicit filtered VANTAGE
  probe-sni-survival         EXIT_IP=… bare/www SNI survival probe (run on RU vantage)
  probe-asn HOST=…           Team Cymru ASN lookup
  install-hooks              Install pre-commit hooks
  task-tools                 Install pinned mdtask and OpenSpec tools
  task-check                 Validate task, mdtask, OpenSpec, board, and history contracts
  task-list                  List portfolio tasks
  task-ready                 Show the unblocked execution frontier
  task-graph                 Render the local task dependency graph
  task-federation PEER_ROOT=…  Validate the combined RIPDPI backlog graph

── DEPLOY LIFECYCLE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  init                       terraform init in $TF_ROOT
  validate                   fmt + validate + gitleaks + ansible-lint
  decrypt                    sops --decrypt → $SECRETS_FILE
  plan                       terraform plan -out=$TFPLAN
  apply                      terraform apply $TFPLAN
  inventory                  Render Ansible inventory from TF outputs
  wait                       Wait for cloud-init to finish
  pre-deploy-check           spot-check-secrets + check-certs (auto for deploy/verify; SKIP_PRECHECK=1 to bypass)
  backup-configure          Configure one exact ANSIBLE_LIMIT during an exclusive stopped-backup window; never runs backups or timers
  dry-run                    Serial exact-node check; requires DEPLOY_SSH_CONTEXTS_FILE
  migrate-ssh-ownership      Explicit one-node policy-preserving SSH ownership transaction
  staging-tailnet-controller-loss-test  Prove autonomous lease recovery after controller SIGKILL
  staging-tailnet-reboot-recovery-test  Prove two-phase recovery across a real reboot
  deploy                     Serial exact-node transaction; requires promotion and fresh baseline-failure receipt mappings
  deploy-canary              Deploy ENV=canary through the normal deploy flow
  os-maintenance             Rolling full OS upgrade + required reboot + verification
  verify [TAG_ON_SUCCESS=1]  ACTIVE checks; watchdog may restart services (+ optional tag)
  inspect INSPECT_HOSTS=…    Passive SSH observation of exact comma-separated inventory names
  source-drift               Require live deployable digest to match the clean checkout
  security-verify            Host hardening checks (SSH/sysctl/firewall/services)
  staging-cleanup-manifest   Bind one provider-owned ci-staging state to a private cleanup manifest
  staging-cleanup-reissue    Refresh a registered idle node from its previous manifest
  staging-destroy            Destroy only the exact manifest-bound staging resources
  awg-evidence-provision     Provision the three-host AWG evidence lane (after decrypt)
  smoke-test                 End-to-end traffic test through every enabled profile
  clean                      shred $SECRETS_FILE

── ROLLBACK / RECOVERY ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  rollback-xray              Roll Xray back to ROLLBACK_XRAY_VERSION=vX.Y.Z on one node (ANSIBLE_LIMIT=<alias>)
  rollback-config            Revert Xray to .prev config on one node (ANSIBLE_LIMIT=<alias>)
  rotate-credentials         Rotate per-client UUIDs / passwords / peer keys on one node (ANSIBLE_LIMIT=<alias>, repeat per node)
  destroy                    Safe terraform destroy (double confirmation)
  backup-state               age-encrypt the local terraform state
  drift-since-tag            Diff fleet against last vpn-deploy-known-good-* tag
  blue-green GREEN_ENV=<name>  Orchestrate single-host blue-green
  fleet-rotate PLAN=…        Coordinated rotation across fleet (--dry-run / --resume)
  protocol-liveness LIVENESS_CONFIG=…  Pull sentinel probes and evaluate quorum
  monitor-protocol-liveness LIVENESS_CONFIG=…  Persist and alert on protocol-liveness transitions
  install-liveness-sentinel LIVENESS_CONFIG=… SENTINEL=… CLIENT=…  Secure sentinel onboarding
  prepare-disposable-liveness EXECUTOR_PROFILE=… EXECUTOR_MANIFEST=…  Create one no-mount executor
  prepare-disposable-promotion-intent  Assemble private intent/mapping locally from PROMOTION_* environment inputs
  install-disposable-liveness-sentinel …  Bind and onboard one disposable sentinel from stdin
  protocol-liveness-disposable …  Evaluate one exact executor-bound report
  deonboard-disposable-liveness …  Remove the exact assignment after guarded provider absence
  retire-unbound-staging-client …  Remove one unbound issued staging identity after verified absence
  retire-unbound-staging-executor  Remove its never-bound prepared executor after client retirement
  watch-spare                Cron: probe blue, push OTP-gated promote alert
  promote-spare OTP=…        Consume OTP and swing traffic to GREEN_ENV

── CLIENT / DELIVERY ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  emit-xray CLIENT=…         Native Xray P1 JSON (one loopback SOCKS listener per endpoint)
  emit-singbox CLIENT=…      Official sing-box P0/P2 JSON (multi-host + cohort aware)
  emit-awg CLIENT=…          AmneziaWG wg-quick .conf for a named peer
  emit-bundle CLIENT=…       RIPDPI P0/P1/P2 JSON with ripdpi extension
  emit-qr CLIENT=…           PNG QR for the client (TYPE=singbox|uri, OUT=path)
  issue-bootstrap CLIENT=…   Issue a one-time /bootstrap/<token> URL
  naive-issue/revoke/readout CLIENT=…  Manage one encrypted Naive device (SOPS_FILE=…)
  issue-sub-token CLIENT=…   Issue a long-lived /sub/<token> URL (FORMAT=singbox|ripdpi EXPIRES=… QR=1)
  client-drift CLIENT=…      Compare a device's last delivery identity with current inputs
  sub-reads [SINCE=… ROUTE=… LIMIT=…]  Pull the server-side read-audit log
  check-killswitch BUNDLE=…  Validate the kill-switch properties of a bundle

── PRE-DEPLOY GUARDS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  spot-check-secrets         Decrypted-secrets audit (placeholders, certs, …)
  check-certs                selected-profile SAN / trust / validity / server purpose / key match
  audit-permissions          Local FS: age key 0600, no stray plaintext
  diff-secrets               Drift: deployed config vs current secrets

── OBSERVABILITY / DEFENSIVE ──────────────────────────────────────────
  observability-{render,validate}  Local template/syntax validation
  observability-{check,status}  Explicit exact-host inspection
  observability-pki-prepare  Encrypt private-IP SAN PKI for existing collector/observer
  observability-{drill,deploy,rotate,rollback,remove}  Confirmed exact-host lifecycle
  observability-staging-prepare  Create a new private staging input root
  observability-staging-materialize  Decrypt the prepared runtime fragment locally
  observability-staging-acceptance  Advance one fixed disposable acceptance row
  observability-staging-cleanup-{preflight,snapshot,seal,validate}  Prepare exact three-provider cleanup
  observability-staging-cleanup  Destroy sealed staging scope and prove provider absence
  burn-check                 External IP reachability probe
  asn-drift                  Alert on VPS ASN reassignment
  check-ip-reputation        Spamhaus / optional FireHOL file / AbuseIPDB
  probing-summary            7-day Xray/nginx/honeypot rollup
  xray-diagnostics           Fresh redacted Xray counters via local StatsService
  tspu-canary                Daily TSPU rule-drift probes (in-cohort box)
  test-tls-policing HOST=…   Probe the ~12-concurrent-TLS home-ISP rule
  probe-payload-throttle HOST=… Probe per-ASN ~16 KiB payload throttling
  snell-refinement BUNDLE=… CONFIG=… VANTAGE=…  Run staged Snell refinement matrix
  fleet-status [HOSTS=…]     Summary table across every host:env pair
  install-operator-crons     Wire all of the above into crontab as a managed block
  remove-operator-crons      Strip the vpn-deploy cron block

── AUDIT / SUPPLY CHAIN ───────────────────────────────────────────────
  audit-log                  Decrypt and print the credential-issuance log
  audit-log-append ACTION=…  Append a record (operator-driven hook)
  emit-sbom                  CycloneDX SBOM of pinned binaries → sbom/<label>.json
  security-audit             Non-blocking host audit report (Lynis/listeners/systemd/nft/sshd/sysctl)
  pyinfra-audit              Experimental read-only host audit (requires PYINFRA_HOSTS=host[,host])

── TEST / CI ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  test-unit                  Run portable pytest tests; selected skips fail
  test-unit-shard            Run one balanced pytest group (PYTEST_GROUP=1..4)
  test-unit-profile          Refresh durations with a complete portable run
  test-native-runtime        Run native integration tests in disposable Linux root environment
  test-four-transport-native Complete four-transport source/client acceptance in isolated Linux
  test-awg-source-candidate  Build and exercise exact AWG source pairs in local Docker (build-gate required)
```
